app.name: Jadal
app.tagline: Fair canal water for every farm

login.rolesHint: The farmer sees their own turns and asks for water. The coordinator approves plans and can alert farmers.
login.noteBody: There is no self sign-up. The two passwords are set by whoever runs this copy. If you need access, ask your canal coordinator.
login.title: Sign in to Jadal
login.lead: Choose who you are, then enter the password for that role.
login.error: That did not match. Check the password and the role you picked.

fixture.reasonMaizeTasseling: My maize is tasseling and the leaves are rolling in the heat.
fixture.reasonTailShortTurn: My field at the tail end got a short turn.
fixture.reasonPaddyFlowering: I need water urgently, my paddy is flowering.
fixture.noteTailShort: Tail end was short last turn.

footer.text: Jadal helps a village committee share canal water fairly.

home.title: Canal water shared by volume, not by hours.
home.subtitle: Jadal plans each farm's share of canal water in cubic metres, works out how long each turn should run, and phones every farmer in Telugu. The coordinator approves every plan.
home.step1: Farmers register their land and crops.
home.step2: Jadal works out how much water each crop needs this week.
home.step3: The coordinator checks and approves the plan.
home.step4: Each farm gets a turn long enough to receive its share.
home.step5: Every farmer gets a phone call with the turn time.
home.step6: Every cubic metre is written in the water accounts.
home.loopLabel: Urgent requests, rain and harvests change the plan, and Jadal re-plans.
home.farmerCardBody: Check your next turn, ask for extra water or register your land.
home.coordinatorCardBody: Check farmers, approve plans and answer requests.
home.canalCardBody: See how far the water travels and which farms are left short.
home.phoneCardBody: Hear the call a farmer gets about the next turn.
home.demoCardBody: Follow the whole story in about three minutes.

farmer.title: My water
farmer.lead: See your next turn, ask for extra water and register your land.

coordinator.title: Coordinator console
coordinator.lead: Approve what Jadal proposes. Nothing reaches a farmer until you do.

canal.title: Canal water map
canal.lead: See how far the water travels and which farms are left short.

phone.title: Simulated phone call
phone.lead: The call a farmer gets about the next turn. Try it here, no phone line needed.

demo.title: Demo walkthrough
demo.lead: Follow one week on the canal in six steps. Press Start, then run each step.

mywater.turnWater: About {m3} flows through your outlet during this turn.
mywater.turnWhyShare: Your field's share this week is {share}. More water leaves the outlet because some soaks into the channel on the way.
mywater.turnWhyNoShare: More water leaves the outlet than reaches your field, because some soaks into the channel on the way.
mywater.noTurnBody: Your turn appears here once the coordinator approves the schedule. You will also get a phone call.

shareStatus.proposed: Waiting for the coordinator to approve this.
shareStatus.edited: The coordinator changed this amount and approved it.

mywater.need: Your crops need about {mm} mm more water this week.
mywater.mmHelp: 1 mm of water over one hectare is 10 m³.
mywater.noShareBody: The coordinator plans your weekly water after checking your registration.
mywater.notStarted: Nothing delivered yet. We start counting after your first turn.
mywater.needMet: So far your crops have got {pct} of the water they need.
mywater.noQuotaBody: Your quota is set once the coordinator approves your registration.
mywater.noLandBody: Register your land and crops on the Register tab.
mywater.askTitle: Is your crop short of water?
mywater.askBody: Ask the committee for extra water.
mywater.noFarmerBody: Register a farmer first. The coordinator checks the registration before water is planned.

register.title: Register your land and crops
register.intro: Fill this in once a season. The coordinator checks it before you get any water.
register.name: Your full name
register.cropsHint: You can grow more than one crop on a plot. The shares must add up to 100% or less.
register.successDetail: The coordinator will check it before the first turn.
register.next3: You get a phone call with your turn time.
register.errPhone: Enter a phone number with at least 10 digits.
register.errArea: Plot size must be more than 0.
register.errCrop: Choose a crop in every row.
register.errSowing: Enter a sowing date that is not in the future.
register.errShare: Each share must be between 1 and 100.
register.errShareSum: The shares add up to more than 100%.

ask.title: Ask for extra water
ask.intro: Say how much you need and why. The coordinator decides.
ask.type: Where should the water come from?

urgent.title: From my own quota
urgent.body: You get water sooner. It is taken out of your later turns.

buffer.title: From the shared pool
buffer.body: Water kept back for all farmers. The coordinator decides.

ask.reasonHint: For example: my rice is flowering and the field is drying out.
ask.success: Request sent. The coordinator will decide, and you will get a call.
ask.mineEmptyTitle: You haven't asked for water yet
ask.mineEmptyBody: When you send a request, you can follow its answer here.
ask.decisionRejected: The coordinator did not approve this.
ask.errVolume: Enter an amount of water more than 0.
ask.urgentCallNote: An urgent request also asks the agent to call you.
ask.callFailed: The request was raised, but the agent call could not be queued.

pool.title: Shared pool
pool.intro: Some water is kept back for everyone. Every request and every decision is shown here, so all farmers can see it is fair.
pool.emptyTitle: Nobody has asked the pool yet
pool.emptyBody: When a farmer asks for pool water, the request and the coordinator's answer appear here.

req.title: Requests for extra water
req.sub: Farmers ask for water outside their normal turn. Check each one and decide.
req.emptyBody: When a farmer asks for extra water, it appears here. You can try it from the Farmer screen.

suggest.partial: Jadal suggests giving {m3} of the {asked} asked.

req.decideFailed: That decision could not be saved. Please try again.
req.notDispatched: Recorded. Nothing has been sent to the farmer yet. Use Alert this farmer to tell them.

ent.title: Weekly water shares
ent.sub: Jadal suggests how much water each crop gets this week. Change any amount, then approve.
ent.emptyBody: Shares appear once farmers are registered and checked. Start with the Farmers tab.
ent.approveQuestion: Approve {n} weekly shares? Farmers see them right away.
ent.how: Each share comes from the crop's growth stage, this week's weather and the rain that has fallen.
ent.mmHelp: Crop need is the depth of water the crop needs this week. 1 mm over one hectare is 10 m³.

roster.title: Turn schedule
roster.sub: Choose how to share one release of canal water. Farms at the tail end get less flow, so equal hours do not mean equal water.
roster.headline: With equal water the last farm gets {water} of its need. With equal hours it gets {hours}.
roster.approvedNotice: Schedule approved. {n} farmers are being called with their turn times.
roster.emptyBody: Jadal proposes a schedule once a release window is announced. Check again in a moment.
roster.approveQuestion: Approve this schedule for {n} farmers? They are called right away.

equal_water.title: Equal water
equal_water.body: Each farm gets its share of water. Farms at the tail end run longer to make up for losses on the way.

equal_hours.title: Equal hours
equal_hours.body: Every farm gets the same length of time. Farms at the tail end get less water.

edit.backwards: The end time must be after the start time.
edit.invalid: Enter a valid start and end time.
edit.error: The time could not be saved. Please try again.

farmers.title: Farmers
farmers.sub: Check each new registration before the farmer gets water.
farmers.checked: {name} is checked and can now get water.
farmers.emptyBody: New registrations appear here after a farmer registers on the Farmer screen.

acc.title: Water accounts
acc.sub: Where every cubic metre of this season's canal water has gone.
acc.balanced: The books balance. Every cubic metre is accounted for.
acc.unbalanced: The books do not balance. Ask the auditor to check.
acc.noEntries: No water has moved yet. Entries appear once turns are delivered.
acc.emptyBody: Accounts appear once the season's supply is set.

alert.title: Alert this farmer
alert.messageHint: Leave empty to send the standard message.
alert.simulated: Simulated only: no real {channel} was sent. {severity} level. {detail}
alert.error: The alert could not be sent. Please try again.
alert.allocationHelp: The farmer hears how much water they have and when to use it. Both come from the approved request and their turn.
alert.allocationNone: No approved allocation for this farmer yet. Approve their request (or plan their turn) first.
alert.allocationOn: Include the allocation in this alert

canal.head: Head
canal.mapCaption: A thicker ribbon means more flow. The canal thins out because some water soaks into the ground along the way.
canal.shareSub: Compare two ways to share a release. The bars show how much of each farm's need is met.
canal.equalHoursHint: Every farm gets the same turn length.
canal.equalWaterHint: Turns are sized so each farm gets its share.
canal.needMetList: How much of each farm's water need is met
canal.fairnessNote: Under equal hours the tail farms fall short. Equal water closes the gap. Fairness gap: {hours} with equal hours, {water} with equal water (lower is fairer).
canal.overrunTitle: What if a turn runs over?
canal.overrunSub: If one farmer keeps the water past their turn, farms further down the canal lose water.
canal.overrunNone: No overrun, so nothing is lost downstream.
canal.overrunTailNote: The last outlet has no farms below it, so nothing is lost downstream.
canal.flowsHelp: Flow is the water passing each outlet, in cubic metres per second.

phone.title: Phone
phone.replyPlaceholder: Type your reply in Telugu or English
phone.micNote: This browser can't record. Send a voice clip instead.
phone.declined: You declined the call. The committee will try WhatsApp.
phone.demoSound: Demo sound. The real call speaks the message in Telugu.
phone.try1: Press Accept to answer the call.
phone.try2: Type a reply in Telugu or English and press Send.
phone.try3: Open WhatsApp messages to see the alerts this farmer also gets.
phone.reachSub: Every farmer gets a phone call. Farmers with a smartphone also get WhatsApp.
phone.reachEmptyBody: Calls appear here after the coordinator approves a schedule.
phone.agentCallLead: The agent answers and speaks in Telugu.
phone.agentCallSimulated: Simulated call: the agent's reply plays on this device only.
phone.agentCallNoSpeech: This device cannot speak. The reply is written below.
phone.agentCallError: The agent's reply could not be loaded.

demo.resetQuestion: Reset the demo? Everything you have run so far is cleared.
demo.stepFailed: This step did not finish. Try again.
demo.bufferReason: Short of water at the tail end of my field.

status.stepDone: Step {n} is done. Step {next} is next.

demo.clockHelp: Move time forward to see later events.
demo.logEmpty: Nothing yet. Start the demo to fill this list.

1.title: Share water fairly
1.what: The coordinator compares equal hours with equal water for the next release.

2.title: A farmer asks for urgent water
2.what: A rice farmer at the head of the canal asks by Telugu voice. Jadal suggests a partial grant and the coordinator approves it.

3.title: Re-plan and call every farmer
3.what: The schedule is updated and Jadal phones each farmer. Farmers without a smartphone get a call only.

4.title: Warn farmers before a night release
4.what: A release starts at night, so each farmer gets a WhatsApp message and a call one hour before.

5.title: A harvest frees water for others
5.what: A cotton farmer finishes the harvest. The unused water goes to the shared pool, and another farmer asks for some.

6.title: Check that every cubic metre adds up
6.what: The auditor checks the books and compares fairness before and after.

outcome.1: Tail farms now get {after} of their need instead of {before}. The fairness gap falls from {giniBefore} to {giniAfter}.
outcome.2: {name} asked for {asked}. The coordinator approved {granted}, taken from their later turns.
outcome.2no: {name} asked for {asked}. The coordinator did not approve it.
outcome.3: {n} farmers are being called with their new turn times. {names} have no smartphone, so they get a phone call only. Everyone else also gets WhatsApp.
outcome.3all: {n} farmers are being called with their new turn times. Everyone also gets WhatsApp.
outcome.4: The next release starts {when}. {n} farmers get a WhatsApp message and a warning call one hour before.
outcome.5: The shared pool now holds {pool}. {name} asked it for {asked}.
outcome.6: The books balance. The fairness gap is now {giniAfter}, down from {giniBefore}.
outcome.6bad: The books do not balance. Check the water accounts.

events.release_window_announced: A water release was announced for {when}.
events.request_triaged: A request was sorted by urgency.
events.request_recommended: Jadal suggested an answer to a request.
events.week_released_to_buffer: {name} gave a week's water to the shared pool.
events.contact_updated: A call or message changed status.
